mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_user) AS total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_user WHERE enabled = TRUE) AS enabled_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_session WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS active_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_authorization_profile WHERE enabled = TRUE AND revoked_at IS NULL) AS active_profiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_permission_template_version) AS template_versions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_audit_log WHERE occurred_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS audit_events_today
